discrepancies: auction tooling called the later same-sequence tx 0xe2eb61b1 (17806552 idx 3) 'reverted'. The recipient 0xfa9b97d6 is not identified by any saved source (The Block / Metronome pages saved under site/raw/web-curve-sushi are Cloudflare challenge pages, unreadable); on chain it forwarded 786.5467 ETH to Gnosis Safe 0xd1de3f9cd4ae2f23da941a67ca4c739f8dd9af33 at block 17813555 (tx 0x650a73bfff233815ec6c4de22f105ddff8d5194d10b7375b3cdcd23ec6469f9a) and kept the rest (not traced further).
